reviews.review:
When the femboy at my workplace told me he had made a game, I, as a capital G Gamer, asked him what it was about. He told me it was a simple visual novel about a girl who loved apples. 
I... Didn't really care.
VNs just aren't my jam, but, as a good friend, i decided to give the ♥♥♥♥♥♥ a wishlisted and waited for the release. Truth be told, i didn't expect much but after actually seeing the art, i became far warmer towards this little labour of love. Speaking of art: fun fact, to our mutual hilarity, i commented that i expected cringy DeviantArt level art/ bad early 2000's anime trash and he knew exactly what i meant. After playing the game (and getting distracted, leading to a 4 hour romp turning into a 10 hour journey), i can't say i wasn't endeared.
Normaly, i would use bulletpoints to help anyone reading this review quickly decide if their interested but there isn't much to talk about. Its a basic, linear VN with 0 choices with some really nice pop-out storybook visuals presenting a little story about a girl who likes apples. Credit where it's due, one of our other coworker wept after fininshing the story, so it certainly has soul and character. On my end, i had a cheesy grin as the story concluded because i ♥♥♥♥♥♥♥ called the ending as soon as the last act started. 
My only big problem with the game is the english script is ♥♥♥♥♥♥♥ ROUGH (but please, forgive him. he is... *French*. I'll give you a moment). But, fear not! i heard some fat bastard is working on making the translation more palatable for those who speak a language that doesn't smell like cheese (Coming January 2026).
TL;DR: you like VNs? You like amateurish charm? you like neat art and soulfull stories you can finish in less than an afternoon? Give it a shot, you might be surprised.

Also, PUT MY ♥♥♥♥♥♥♥ QUOTE ON THE STORE PAGE, ♥♥♥♥♥!!!
